nonclaims: Does not replace exact Stage13 decoded-surface raster qualification.
Does not make foreground masks an inference input.
Does not use teacher mesh vertices normals triangles barycentrics or identities.
Does not prove Knight Stage13 pass.
rationale: V5 causal diagnosis showed sparse ray supervision was being asked to satisfy a dense 1024x1024 source-raster gate. This policy adds direct dense source-coverage pressure while keeping the learner forward RGB+camera only and preserving the exact hard Stage13 gate.
